task: add a plugin for an organization

families.label: Admin uploads a plugin archive on the Plugins card/page

variants.label: Config > Plugins card: drop the zip, then choose Auto-install or Members choose
preconditions: a plugin zip (a .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest plus the skill folders under skills/)
a skill distributed this way must contain only text files (.md, .txt, .json, .yaml, .yml, .csv)
steps: Open the Config page in the admin portal
Check the preview showing the plugin's name, version, and description (a skills-only package is not marked Runs code)
Choose Auto-install to deliver it to every member, or Members choose to let members install it themselves
Optionally verify on a device: open Claude Desktop as a member, install it if you chose Members choose, and give Claude a task the skill should match

sources.anchor: ## Building and deploying your own skills

variants.label: claude.ai/admin-settings/plugins: Add plugins > Upload a file, then attach to a bundle or scope
preconditions: a .zip or .plugin archive of up to 200 MB laid out as a Claude Code plugin: a .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest at the archive root with skills at skills/<name>/SKILL.md, the same layout inside one top-level folder, or a single top-level SKILL.md
steps: Go to the Plugins page at claude.ai/admin-settings/plugins
Click Add plugins and choose Upload a file
Upload the .zip or .plugin archive (an archive with no manifest, more than one plugin.json, or a misplaced manifest is rejected at upload)
After upload the plugin is in the organization's catalog but attached nowhere
Toggle the plugin on in a bundle's Plugins tab, or add it directly on a scope, to make it available in channels

sources.anchor: ## Upload a plugin as a zip file

claude-gov.note: Delivery is settled at upload time by an explicit install-behavior choice: Auto-install or Members choose. Distributed skills must be text-only.

claude-tag.note: Upload only puts the plugin in the org catalog; a second gate (toggle on in a bundle's Plugins tab, or add on a scope) is what makes it reach channels. 200 MB archive cap.

summary: Both documented products upload a plugin zip in an admin console; Government picks an install behavior, Claude Tag must attach the plugin to a bundle.
open_questions: Claude Tag's Sync from GitHub path sits in the same Add plugins menu and also ends with toggling plugins on in a bundle; whether that path should be a second variant here or stays under T-034/T-049 is unsettled by these records.
Claude Tag documents no equivalent of Auto-install vs Members choose, so whether a Tag admin can force a plugin on members is unknown.
No records for claude, claude-web, claude-desktop, claude-desktop-3p, or cowork; the absences may reflect pilot unit coverage rather than the products lacking the capability.
